summary: Tested the two NEW P0 features from this session. TASK 1 ('Missed On Plan' — structured-plan missed rides surfaced in GET /api/rider/missed, with skip/reschedule via POST /api/rider/missed/resolve) is VERIFIED WORKING end-to-end, both via a new pytest suite and a live manual reproduction against greenlantern@roujaune.app (temporarily shifted the plan's start date 10 days into the past via POST /api/plan/start-date to organically produce 3 past-due, uncompleted structured-plan cycling days, since the seed data's real current week had none past-due). Confirmed: (a) GET /api/rider/missed returned 3 entries shaped 'plan:couch-to-road:<workout_id>' with kind:'structured', (b) skip on ctr-ride-1 returned ok:true and the entry disappeared from a subsequent GET, (c) reschedule on ctr-ride-2 to tomorrow (2026-09-13) returned ok:true + date, disappeared from missed, and correctly appeared as a rider-scheduled entry in GET /api/calendar/week for that date (status:'scheduled', color:'yellow', rescheduled_from set). Regression-verified the pre-existing ad-hoc (entry_id NOT starting with 'plan:') skip/reschedule flow still works identically via a new pytest test (create past-due scheduled_workouts row -> appears in missed -> skip/reschedule -> verified via GET). All test-induced state (plan start-date override, plan_skips docs, the rescheduled scheduled_workouts row) was reverted/cleaned up afterward via POST /api/plan/undo-reschedule + direct cleanup so greenlantern's account is back to its pre-test state (start_date 2026-09-26, current_week 1). TASK 2 (full month calendar grid in ChangeStartDateModal) is VERIFIED WORKING via Playwright on a 390x844 mobile viewport: month/year header with working prev/next arrows, Mo-Su weekday header, tappable day cells, today (Sep 12) marked with a small dot, past days (1-11) dimmed/disabled, tapping a day updates both the 'Set start to ...' confirm button and the top selected-date label ('startdate-label'). prev-month arrow is correctly non-functional at the current calendar month (clicked it, month label stayed 'September 2026' — confirmed via the label not changing, not just visual opacity). next-month arrow correctly jumped 3 months ahead (Sep -> Dec 2026) and a day in that far month could be selected and set as the new start (confirmed via a live end-to-end confirm that returned a real toast: 'Restarted From Couch to Road on 2026-09-13...' after switching back via the Tomorrow chip). The 3 quick chips (Tomorrow/Next Monday/In 2 weeks) correctly synced the grid back to the right month (Dec 2026 -> Sep 2026 when 'Tomorrow' was tapped) and highlighted the matching day. This test-induced start-date confirm was also reverted via undo-reschedule afterward.

TASK 1: POST /api/rider/missed/resolve action:'skip' on a structured entry -> ok:true, entry removed from subsequent GET /api/rider/missed.

TASK 1: POST /api/rider/missed/resolve action:'reschedule' on a structured entry with a future date -> ok:true + date, entry removed from missed, new rider-scheduled entry appears in GET /api/calendar/week for that date.
TASK 1: Regression — ad-hoc (non-'plan:') missed-workout skip/reschedule flow works identically to before (own pytest test, create->missed->resolve->verify).
TASK 1: Invalid entry_id format ('plan:badformat') and invalid action both correctly return 400.
TASK 2: Full month calendar grid renders with month/year header, prev/next arrows, Mo-Su weekday header, 6x7 day grid.
TASK 2: Today (Sep 12, 2026) marked with a small dot; past days (1-11) visually dimmed and non-clickable.
TASK 2: Tapping a day cell updates both the confirm button label ('Set start to ...') and the top selected-date label.
TASK 2: prev-month arrow is non-functional (verified label unchanged after click, not just opacity) when viewing the current calendar month.
TASK 2: next-month arrow correctly navigates multiple months ahead (3 clicks: Sep 2026 -> Dec 2026) and a day in a far month can be selected.
TASK 2: The 3 quick chips (Tomorrow/Next Monday/In 2 weeks) correctly jump the grid back to the right month and highlight the matching day.

TASK 2: Confirming a far-off date change via the grid actually calls POST /api/plan/start-date successfully (observed real toast 'Restarted From Couch to Road on 2026-09-13 — every session shifts with the new start.' with working Undo).
